scripts.smoke: npm run build && esbuild src/smoke.stdio.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --outfile=dist/smoke.stdio.mjs --banner:js="import{createRequire}from'module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" && node dist/smoke.stdio.mjs
